value.rationale: The full pairwise Euclidean metric census is a natural invariant of the canonical Hansen polytope and directly specifies all graph-filtration thresholds for its vertex cloud. The nontrivial finding is that pairs split into two macroscopically separated scales, each of different asymptotic Gaussian variance. This persists for an infinite natural graph family and cannot be inferred from the known single-branch Fibonacci Hosoya polynomial alone.
